chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUdhāfir, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, walking behind the جنازة is better than walking in front of it, and there is no harm in walking in front of it.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more excellent; indicating superiority in merit, not obligation
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or funeral procession
key_terms.الْمَشْيَ: walking; the act of proceeding with the funeral procession
key_terms.بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا: in front of it; ahead of the funeral procession
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind; indicating the preferred position relative to the funeral
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a formula indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it better to walk behind a funeral bier or in front of it in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning funeral etiquette, stating that walking behind the جنازة is preferable to walking ahead of it. At the same time, it clarifies that walking in front of it is permissible and not forbidden.
